patterns.note: Full-width sections with content constrained to a central maximum width, often using alternating background colors or gradients for clear visual separation.
Prominent, oversized sans-serif headings are paired with a lighter weight sans-serif for body text, maintaining a clean and modern typographic hierarchy.
A vibrant, multi-color gradient (pink, orange, yellow, light blue) is used as a dynamic background in the hero section, contrasting with more subdued solid background colors for subsequent sections.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining its initial size and appearance as the user scrolls down the page.
The hero section features a multi-color gradient background that appears to be fixed or very slowly parallaxing, allowing foreground content (text, form, phone graphic) to scroll over it.
Feature sections frequently combine custom, playful illustrations with concise text blocks to explain concepts, adding a friendly and approachable tone to the content.

technique_notes: Implement a persistent header navigation using a fixed position, ensuring it remains visible and unchanged as the user scrolls down the page.
Create a layered depth effect in the hero section by setting a fixed or slow-parallaxing background element, over which the primary content scrolls normally.
Utilize full-width, multi-color linear gradients as background fills for key sections to create a vibrant and dynamic visual separation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a clean, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, with more pronounced, device-like rounding on product mockups.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact arrangement within feature grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of vibrant, multi-color gradients and playful custom illustrations, particularly in the hero and feature sections, creates a surprisingly approachable and friendly aesthetic for a financial product like credit scores. This contrasts with the typically serious and data-heavy visual language found in the industry.
